sentences.en: Good morning and welcome to City Football Club.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎来到城市足球俱乐部。

sentences.en: I'd like to give you some useful information about your visit to the stadium today and then we'll start the tour of the areas of the stadium that are open to visitors.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家介绍一些关于今天参观体育场的有用信息，然后我们将开始参观对游客开放的体育场区域。

sentences.en: I can see lots of children here today, so just to let mums and dads know a few things before we start.
sentences.zh: 我看到今天这里有很多孩子，所以先向各位家长说明几件事。

sentences.en: The stadium has lots of stairs and the players' tunnel is very dark.
sentences.zh: 体育场内有很多楼梯，球员通道也非常昏暗。

sentences.en: Please don't let your children wander off on their own, even for a minute.
sentences.zh: 请务必不要让孩子独自走开，哪怕只是一分钟。

sentences.en: We don't want any accidents or anyone getting frightened.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望发生任何意外，也不希望有人受到惊吓。

sentences.en: Cameras are permitted everywhere and you can take pictures of your child shooting a penalty.
sentences.zh: 相机在所有区域都允许使用，您还可以为孩子罚点球的瞬间拍照留念。

sentences.en: Assistants are helping to organise this and hopefully the queue won't be too long.
sentences.zh: 工作人员正在协助组织这项活动，希望排队时间不会太长。

sentences.en: It's very hot and sunny out on the pitch today.
sentences.zh: 今天球场外天气炎热且阳光强烈。

sentences.en: You can get food and drink at the cafe and I really recommend the healthy lunch boxes for children Also in the cafe children are invited to do a football drawing We pick the best one at the end of the afternoon so don forget to put your name and contact details on the back That way if you've left the stadium before then, we'll send your prize, but sadly we can't return drawings.
sentences.zh: 您可以在咖啡馆购买食物和饮料，我特别推荐儿童健康午餐盒。此外，在咖啡馆里，孩子们还可以参与足球主题绘画活动。我们将在下午结束时评选出最佳作品，因此请务必在画作背面写上您的姓名和联系方式。这样，即使您在结果公布前已离开体育场，我们也能将奖品寄送给您；但很遗憾，我们无法退还画作。

sentences.en: I'd like to mention some features of the tour.
sentences.zh: 我想介绍一下本次导览的一些特色。

sentences.en: We'll start with the 360 cinema experience, which has been very popular over the years, and then I'll take you to the players' dressing rooms, before going outside to the seating area and the pitch.
sentences.zh: 我们将首先体验360度影院，这一项目多年来一直广受欢迎；随后我将带大家前往球员更衣室，再走出室外，参观观众席和球场。

sentences.en: I should say, if you'd prefer your visit to be self -guided, please collect headphones from the reception, and then you can listen to the pre -recorded information at your own speed.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，如果您更倾向于自助导览，请在接待处领取耳机，然后您可以按照自己的节奏收听预先录制的讲解内容。

sentences.en: We've only just introduced this feature and would appreciate your feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚推出这一服务，非常期待听到您的反馈意见。

sentences.en: We're thinking of offering tours in other languages in future, so if you have any thoughts on that, we'd welcome those too.
sentences.zh: 我们正在考虑未来提供其他语言的导览服务，如果您对此有任何想法，我们也非常欢迎提出。

sentences.en: If you plan to return another time, you might like to book one of our VIP tours.
sentences.zh: 如果您计划日后再次来访，或许可以预订我们的VIP导览服务。

sentences.en: We've only just started offering these and they can be booked online.
sentences.zh: 这类导览服务我们刚刚开始提供，可在线预订。

sentences.en: While that project was going on, the team had to play its matches at the ground of another club.
sentences.zh: 在那项工程进行期间，球队不得不前往另一家俱乐部的场地进行比赛。

sentences.en: Apart from that, the club has been here on this site since 1870.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，本俱乐部自1870年起便一直坐落于此地。

sentences.en: As some of you may know, that was the start of a really important decade in the history of football in this country.
sentences.zh: 在座各位中可能有人知道，那正是我国足球史上一个极为重要的十年的开端。

sentences.en: For example, 1870 was also the year that football teams started to include a player whose role it was to guard the goal.
sentences.zh: 例如，1870年也是足球队开始配备一名专职守门员的年份，其职责是守护球门。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine what the game must have been like without someone in that position, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 很难想象，没有这个位置时的比赛会是什么样子，对吧？

sentences.en: In 1872 and 73, man: y other clubs were established, both here and abroad.
sentences.zh: 1872年和1873年，许多其他俱乐部相继成立，不仅在本国，也在海外。

sentences.en: And the following year, in 1874, referees were allowed to send players off if they committed certain offences. and also in that year teams started having to swap ends at half-time.
sentences.zh: 次年，即1874年，裁判被允许将犯有特定犯规行为的球员罚出场；同年，球队也开始必须在中场休息时交换场地。

sentences.en: One fact I was interested to discover was that in early football games the aim was for the scorer to get the ball between two flag posts and later between sticks joined at the top with a piece of tape.
sentences.zh: 我感兴趣发现的一个事实是：早期足球比赛中，进球的目标是将球踢入两根旗杆之间，后来则改为踢入顶部由一条带子连接的两根立柱之间。

sentences.en: In 1875, that tape was replaced with the solid crossbar that we're familiar with today. 1877 saw the founding of further new clubs and the history books tell us that in the same year all the clubs decided to set a limit of 90 minutes for each match Before that it was a more casual arrangement and this sometimes caused huge arguments and sometimes fights during matches when one team called the end of the game and the other team wanted to play on to try and score a winning goal.
sentences.zh: 1875年，那条带子被我们今天所熟悉的实体横梁所取代。1877年，又有更多新俱乐部成立；历史记载显示，同年所有俱乐部一致决定将每场比赛时长限定为90分钟。在此之前，比赛时间安排较为随意，这有时会导致比赛中出现激烈争执，甚至引发斗殴——当一支球队宣布比赛结束，而另一支球队却希望继续比赛以争取打入制胜一球时。

sentences.en: By 1878, the number of teams in the Football League increased again.
sentences.zh: 到1878年，英足总联赛中的球队数量再次增加。

sentences.en: In addition, referees started using whistles and electric lamps were installed on certain pitches.
sentences.zh: 此外，裁判开始使用哨子，某些球场还安装了电灯。

sentences.en: This was a significant change, as games could then be played in the evenings all year round.
sentences.zh: 这是一项重大变革，因为此后比赛全年都可在晚间进行。

sentences.en: In 1880, clubs began to charge fans for admission to games, even though players were still amateurs and had other proper jobs.
sentences.zh: 1880年，各俱乐部开始向观众收取观赛入场费，尽管当时球员仍属业余身份，另有正式职业。

sentences.en: That's hard to imagine in the modern professional game. where top players earn significant sums of money from both playing and commercial activities.
sentences.zh: 在当今职业化程度极高的现代足球中，这确实令人难以想象——顶级球员仅靠踢球和商业活动便能获得巨额收入。
